Questions & Answers
Quick Answers to Common Questions
- There are free EMR systems. But you don’t offer a free one. Why?It’s true that some providers claim to offer free EMR (Electronic Medical Records) systems. However, most of these solutions are either unsafe, unstable, or unsustainable. Many so-called free EMR platforms: 
  - 
Collect and analyse your patient data without proper security.
  - 
Lack strong privacy protection or compliance with healthcare data standards.
  - 
Shut down after a few months, causing you to lose all patient records and clinical history.
 Running a reliable EMR software solution requires continuous development, hosting, and security maintenance. If a provider isn’t charging, they are often earning ROI from your data or cutting corners. At DocPP, we prioritise data security, system reliability, and long-term sustainability—that’s why we don’t offer a “free forever” plan.
- 
- Do you offer a free trial period?Yes. We provide a 14-day free trial of the complete DocPP system. During this time, you can: 
  - 
Run your private practice without limitations.
  - 
Add your own drugs, treatment records, and clinical data.
  - 
Experience the full features of our EMR platform risk-free.
- 
- How can I renew the system?Renewal is fully automated. You can use any Sri Lankan online payment method (Visa, MasterCard, internet banking, mobile wallets, etc.). Once payment is completed, your DocPP subscription is instantly updated with no downtime.
- What is your technical stack?Our healthcare software has been in the industry for over 12 years, trusted by hundreds of medical professionals. In 2022, we completely revamped the platform using the latest PHP 8.x framework, ensuring: 
  - 
High-level security updates.
  - 
Greater system scalability and performance.
  - 
Long-term adaptability for new healthcare technology needs.
- 
- Where is my data hosted?Your data is protected with enterprise-grade AWS security. We use dedicated, non-shared servers to keep your patient records, prescriptions, and medical histories safe, private, and compliant with healthcare security standards.
- Can I lose my data? What about data recovery?No. DocPP has a comprehensive disaster recovery system in place. We perform regular encrypted backups and maintain redundant storage mechanisms to ensure that your patient data is never lost—even in the event of system failure.
- Why should I choose DocPP over other EMR systems?DocPP is a Sri Lankan-built EMR solution designed specifically for local healthcare practices. Unlike generic international software, DocPP is: 
  - 
Tailored for Sri Lankan doctors and clinics (support for local drug databases, workflows, and payment methods).
  - 
Backed since 2008 (nearly 2 decades of real-world use and continuous upgrades.
  - 
Hosted on secure AWS servers with strong data encryption and privacy safeguards.
  - 
Supported by a local technical team for quick assistance.
 This means you get a reliable, affordable, and culturally relevant EMR platform with zero compromise on security.
- 
- Can I access DocPP from anywhere?Absolutely. DocPP is a cloud-based EMR system, meaning you can securely log in from: 
  - 
Your clinic computer.
  - 
A laptop at home.
  - 
A mobile device while travelling.
 All you need is an internet connection. This makes it easy for doctors, nurses, and administrators to work collaboratively in real-time.
- 
- Does DocPP support multiple doctors and staff accounts?Yes. DocPP is built for private practices, clinics, and hospitals. You can create: 
  - 
Separate logins for doctors, receptionists, and administrators.
  - 
Role-specific access levels (e.g., only doctors can view patient prescriptions).
  - 
Shared dashboards to track appointments, billing, and patient history.
 This makes DocPP ideal for solo practitioners and multi-doctor clinics.
- 
- How do I migrate my existing patient records into DocPP?We offer a seamless migration process. Our team can help you: 
  - 
Import Excel, CSV, or legacy EMR data.
  - 
Digitise paper-based records into electronic medical records.
  - 
Ensure data accuracy and security during transfer.
 You won’t lose any patient history — everything will be migrated into your new DocPP account.
- 
- How much does DocPP cost after the free trial?Our pricing is transparent and affordable, designed for Sri Lankan medical professionals. After your 14-day free trial, you can subscribe monthly or annually using any Sri Lankan online payment method. We also offer discounts for multi-doctor clinics and long-term subscriptions.
- Do I need IT knowledge to use DocPP?Not at all. DocPP is designed with doctors and clinic staff in mind — no coding or IT expertise required. The interface is: 
  - 
Simple and user-friendly.
  - 
Customisable with your own drug lists, treatments.
- 
- Does DocPP support e-prescriptions and digital billing?Yes. DocPP allows you to: 
  - 
Create electronic prescriptions with your own customised drug list.
  - 
Generate patient invoices and receipts instantly.
  - 
Accept payments through local online gateways.
  - 
Track outstanding payments and revenue reports in real-time.
 This makes your practice more efficient, professional, and paperless.
- 
- What happens if my internet goes down?DocPP is a cloud-first EMR, so it needs internet access. However: 
  - 
Your data is always safe on AWS servers.
  - 
Once the internet reconnects, you can instantly resume work without losing any records.
  - 
We recommend 4G backup internet or mobile hotspot for uninterrupted access.
- 
- Can DocPP grow with my clinic?Yes. DocPP is fully scalable: 
  - 
Start as a solo practice.
  - 
Add more doctors, branches, or services as your clinic expands.
  - 
Use advanced modules like reporting, inventory, and staff management as you grow.
 You’ll never outgrow the system — DocPP grows with your practice.
- 
- Why Clinics Stay with DocPPWhen clinics choose DocPP, they are not just adopting a product—they’re gaining a long-term partner in healthcare innovation. 
  - Reliable, future-ready technology with continuous updates
  - A team that speaks both the language of doctors and developers
  - Over a decade of proven stability and customer loyalty
  - A client-first philosophy that ensures solutions are tailored, not generic
- Does DocPP has Artificial Intelligent Features (AI Features)Yes, DocPP comes with all users having AI Patient Overview where AI will analyze patient past medical history and come up with suggestions, recommendation and management plans.
